description: This file declares utility functions for creating and managing WebRTC peer connection components, including thread creation, peer connection factory, and peer connection setup, within the 'cuttlefish::webrtc_streaming' namespace.

methods.name: CreateAndStartThread
methods.description: Creates and starts a new RTC thread with the specified name.

methods.name: CreatePeerConnectionFactory
methods.description: Creates a WebRTC peer connection factory using specified network, worker, and signal threads, along with an audio device module.

methods.name: CreatePeerConnection
methods.description: Creates a WebRTC peer connection with specified factory, dependencies, port range, and ICE servers.

calls: Result<rtc::scoped_refptr<webrtc::PeerConnectionFactoryInterface>> CreatePeerConnectionFactory(rtc::Thread* network_thread, rtc::Thread* worker_thread, rtc::Thread* signal_thread, rtc::scoped_refptr<webrtc::AudioDeviceModule> audio_device_module)

Result<rtc::scoped_refptr<webrtc::PeerConnectionInterface>> CreatePeerConnection(rtc::scoped_refptr<webrtc::PeerConnectionFactoryInterface> peer_connection_factory, webrtc::PeerConnectionDependencies dependencies, uint16_t min_port, uint16_t max_port, const std::vector<webrtc::PeerConnectionInterface::IceServer>& per_connection_servers)
